description: AgentCollect connects your AR recovery data to your assistant. Ask "how much did we recover last quarter?", "what's my recovery rate?", or "which accounts paid the most?" and get a complete, business-framed answer scoped strictly to your own account. Read-only, OAuth-secured, no write access.
